entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Just connect me to a person. I'm not dealing with a robot.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Finally! My VeloBand Pulse is a piece of junk and I want my money back. This is ridiculous.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you provide your order number or the email address associated with your account?
It's alex.peters@email.com. And don't give me the runaround. I've had this thing for a month and it's completely broken.

Okay, thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your account now. I see the VeloBand Pulse purchased on December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

A technical fault? It's defective! The heart rate monitor is not working correctly—the numbers are all over the place. On top of that, it won't sync with my phone anymore. I've tried everything. It's just broken.
I see. I understand how frustrating it is when a device isn't performing as expected, especially when it won't sync. Let me just review the return options for a defective item.

Review? What is there to review?! Just send me a return label! If you can't do that, get me your manager. I will light up your social media with reviews about this shoddy product and your terrible service.
I understand your frustration, Alex, and I assure you I can handle this for you. I just need a moment to check our knowledge base for the correct procedure. Please hold.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've checked our system, and I see here that our return policy covers items for 90 days from the date of delivery. Since you received it about 35 days ago, you are well within that window.
So you're going to take it back then? A full refund?

Absolutely. I sincerely apologize for the trouble with the defective band. That's not the quality we aim for at VeloFit. I have just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office.
Oh. Okay, well... that's better. So I'll get the full refund once you receive it?

Yes, that's correct. Once our warehouse scans the return, the full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Alex?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
